mechanism: Captopril reduces renal lithium clearance by decreasing glomerular filtration and increasing proximal tubule reabsorption, leading to increased serum lithium levels and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum lithium levels closely (baseline and 5-7 days after captopril initiation), reduce lithium dose by 25-50%, ensure adequate hydration and stable sodium intake, and consider alternative antihypertensive if possible.
